lines.say: Your code worked perfectly on your laptop.
lines.show: Your code worked *perfectly* on your laptop.

lines.say: At five PM, you put it on the server. One minute later, it crashed.
lines.show: At 5 PM, you put it on the server. One minute later, it [crashed.]

lines.say: Same code. Nobody changed a line.
The server had an older Python, and it was missing a library your code needs.
lines.show: The server had an *older Python,* and it was [missing a library] your code needs.

lines.say: Docker fixes this. Don't ship just your code. Ship your code plus everything it needs, sealed in one box.
lines.show: *Docker* fixes this. Don't ship just your code. Ship [everything it needs,] sealed in one box.

lines.say: Like a shipping container. Truck, ship, or train, what's inside arrives exactly the same.
lines.show: Like a *shipping container.* Truck, ship, or train, what's inside arrives [exactly the same.]

lines.say: You list what goes in the box, in a file called a Dockerfile.
lines.show: You list what goes in the box, in a file called a [Dockerfile.]

lines.say: Docker builds it into an image: your code, Python, every library, frozen together.
lines.show: Docker builds it into an *image:* your code, Python, every library, [frozen together.]

lines.say: Run that image, and you get a container: your app, running inside its box.
lines.show: Run that image, and you get a [container:] your app, running inside its box.

lines.say: Laptop, server, or cloud. The inside is identical.
lines.show: Laptop, server, or cloud. The inside is *identical.*

lines.say: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI skipped.
lines.show: If you're a vibe coder, follow for the system design your AI [skipped.]
